Package com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.client

Class HeldEye

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.client.HeldEye
public final class HeldEye extends Object
The live eye a player holds: one GooglyTracker.EyeInfo pupil, stepped with the same physics as mob eyes from the holder's look and position deltas, plus the behaviors it plays. Only the holder sees it, in first person, so its behaviors start on the holder's own client: now and then it winks, stares, or glances aside; it bulges when the holder is hurt (LivingEntity.hurtTime, set by vanilla's damage event) and swirls when the holder heals. One behavior plays at a time, as on a mob. Cross-eye, which needs a partner eye, and the ongoing mob states (squints, lids, anger, pulse, rattle) don't apply.

It steps only while the holder holds a Googly Eye, and starts at rest, with nothing playing, each time one is picked up or the holder changes.
